subject: general
question: Sandeep Kumari represents India in which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Discus Throw**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• After failing a drug test, Indian** discus thrower Sandeep Kumari **was banned for four years by the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA).
 
• The** National Dope Test Laboratory (NDTL) **had failed to discover the prohibited substance "steroid" in her blood sample discus throw, a sport in sports (track and field) in which a disk-shaped object known as a discus is thrown for distance.
 
• The discus throw is a** circle 2.5 meters (8.2 feet) in diameter and land within a 40° sector **drawn on the ground from the centre of the circle in contemporary competition.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/669d7d06d213f27270ee1e02b1ace36ae25e005aae1d131c51d24e33ba37235d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shooting sports** are a variety of competitive and recreational athletic events that involve accuracy, precision, and speed tests in shooting — the art of employing ranged weapons, primarily man-portable firearms and bows/crossbows.
 
• **Fencing is a subset of three combat sports**. Modern fencing has three disciplines:** foil, épée, and sabre**; points are scored when the weapon makes contact with an opponent.
 
• **Tennis is a racket sport **that may be played solo or between two teams of two players each. Each player strikes a hollow rubber ball coated with felt over or over a net and into the opposing court with a tennis racket connected with string.
